name: ComfyUI H3 Motion Context
tagline: Clip chaining for MiniMax H3 in ComfyUI — motion and audio continue across joins
description: ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context is a custom node that chains MiniMax H3 clips so motion and sound keep going across the cut. Generate clip A, feed its last frames and audio into the node, generate clip B — and B picks up where A left off: same motion, same speed, same direction, and the same audio continued instead of a similar-sounding new take. Nothing on disk is edited; the nodes patch ComfyUI at runtime and verify their assumptions against the live code on every start, refusing to run loudly rather than producing a bad render you do not notice.
highlights: Continues motion, speed, direction, and audio across clip joins
Audio continuation handled as a first-class concern
Runtime patching of ComfyUI, with self-verification on every start
Refuses to run loudly if an update breaks its assumptions
GPL-3.0, from the MiniMax H3 ecosystem
curatorNote: Seamless clip continuation — especially audio — is a real pain point in video generation, and this node solves it with impressive engineering discipline: runtime patching plus self-checking against the live code. A loud failure beats a silent bad render.
